title: DAY 4 — LESSON 4: RECEIVING CORRECTIONS WITHOUT HOSTILITY

questions.prompt: What does receiving correction without hostility mean?
options: Listening, evaluating the concern and responding respectfully
Remaining silent even when the correction is unfair

questions.prompt: A supervisor corrects your work. What is the best response?
options: Listen and ask for clarification where necessary

questions.prompt: Which behaviour is an example of hostility?
options: Insulting or threatening the person giving correction

questions.prompt: What does the CALM method encourage?
options: Controlling reactions, assessing feedback, learning and making adjustments

questions.prompt: What should an employee do when a correction is inaccurate?
options: Explain the facts respectfully and request clarification or review
Retaliate against the person giving correction
